advice.replySubject: Lakeshore Dental Group Workers Compensation: items needed before quoting
advice.replyBody:
Hi Marguerite,

Thank you for sending the Workers Compensation submission for Lakeshore Dental Group, effective Dec 1, 2026. We are glad to look at it alongside the property and general liability we already write.

Before we can send a quote, could you help with the following:

1. Claim count: your email and the Application show 3 claims in the past three years, all closed, but the Quillhaven Mutual loss run shows 4 claims with 1 still open. Please confirm the correct count.
2. Open shoulder claim: please send a current status on the hygienist shoulder claim ($14,300 paid, $6,500 reserved), including expected closure.
3. Signed Application: the applicant statement is unsigned and the name, title and date are blank.
4. Drug-free workplace: please confirm whether they have a drug-free workplace program, as that question is unanswered.
5. Lincoln Park office: please send estimated payroll and job split for the roughly six employees joining in January 2027.

If we can have these soon, we will work toward your Oct 20, 2026 deadline.

Thank you,
Demo User
Antsurance

issues.title: Claim count disagrees
issues.detail: The broker's email says three claims in three years, all closed, and the Application says 3. The Loss run (valued Sep 30, 2026) lists 4 claims totaling $33,150 incurred, with 1 open. Four or more claims would refer the quote to an underwriter.
issues.ask: Confirm the correct claim count for the past three years and explain the difference from the Loss run.

issues.title: Open lost time claim
issues.detail: The Loss run shows a hygienist shoulder repetitive strain claim from Dec 1, 2024 to Dec 1, 2025, lost time, still open with $14,300 paid and $6,500 reserved. The broker's email says all claims are closed.
issues.ask: Provide a current status update on the open shoulder claim, including expected closure and reserve adequacy.

issues.title: Application unsigned
issues.detail: The Application's applicant statement is not signed, and the name, title and date are blank.
issues.ask: Send a signed and dated Application.

issues.title: Drug-free workplace unanswered
issues.detail: The drug-free workplace question on the Application has neither Yes nor No checked, and no other document answers it.
issues.ask: Confirm whether there is a drug-free workplace program.

issues.title: Fourth office opening
issues.detail: The broker's email says a Lincoln Park office opens January 2027, adding about six people, and that payroll is not in the $1,530,000 estimate. This falls within the Dec 1, 2026 to Dec 1, 2027 policy period.
issues.ask: Provide estimated payroll and job split for the Lincoln Park office.

issues.title: Employee count differs
issues.detail: The broker's email and Application give 24 employees (17 clinical, 7 clerical); Antsurance's record shows 22.

issues.title: Payroll growth and partial year
issues.detail: The Loss run shows payroll rising from $1,402,000 to $1,468,000 to an estimated $1,530,000, and the current policy year is valued only through Sep 30, 2026.

issues.title: No return-to-work program
issues.detail: The Application, page 2, answers No to a return-to-work program, alongside an open lost time claim on the Loss run.

advice.headline: Cross-sell Workers Compensation submission from Prairie State Insurance Agency for Lakeshore Dental Group, a three-office Chicago dental practice effective Dec 1, 2026; not ready to quote until the claim count, open claim, unsigned application, drug-free answer and Lincoln Park payroll are resolved.
